surface.name: Projects page
surface.body: The masthead — landing page for the viewer. Lists registered projects in recency order, offers a form to register a new project by absolute path, and links into each project's reading room. Visually the most editorial surface: pulled-up masthead with display-tight title, italic prose, hairline-ruled cards. Empty state reads as a "no projects yet" italic note, not an onboarding CTA.

region.name: Masthead
region.role: Top-of-page newspaper masthead — "Vol. 0 · No. 1 · Local edition" smallcap tagline, oversized "Lexicon" title, italic blurb describing the viewer.

region.name: Register form
region.role: Left column. Absolute-path text input + "Add" submit; rejects invalid paths via server validation and surfaces the error inline. Sits above a small "About this view" italic prose block.

region.name: Registered list
region.role: Right column. One row per registered project — display name, root path in mono, added-at and last-opened-at dates in smallcap. Click anywhere on the row except the "Remove" button to open the project.

region.name: Footer
region.role: Single-line smallcap "Lexicon-viewer · v0 · local edition" under a top rule. Identifies the build; no navigation.
